question.text: USDINR spot is 84.00. A call with strike 83.50 trades at Rs. 0.75. What is the intrinsic value and time value?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook defines call intrinsic value as spot minus strike with a zero floor: intrinsic = max(84.00 - 83.50, 0) = 0.50. Time value is premium minus intrinsic value: 0.75 - 0.50 = 0.25. The Trap: Zero intrinsic would apply only to an OTM option (spot below strike for a call); this call is ITM because spot is above strike, so it carries genuine intrinsic value. Note: Workbook reference — pp.70-71 (intrinsic value formula, time value as premium minus intrinsic, and time value becoming zero at expiry).
